lines.en: Tick tock!

lines.zh: 我可是梦魇里的大买卖人！
lines.en: I'm the big deal maker in the nightmare!
Don't be afraid, I have good stuff!
Check out my weapons!
This is my special item!
Trade, trade!
Check my gear!

lines.zh: 梦魇世界的武器，只我这儿有。
lines.en: Nightmare weapons? Only I sell them.

lines.zh: 来啊，梦魇的买卖人到了。
lines.en: Come now, the nightmare's merchant has arrived.

lines.zh: 我的货挂在骨架上，叮当响。
lines.en: My wares hang from a bone rack and clink.
Follow me; the stall is just ahead.

lines.zh: 梦魇的砂石在我脚下咯吱。
lines.en: Nightmare grit grinds under my feet.

lines.zh: 我数着今天能换几件宝贝。
lines.en: I count what treasures today will trade for.
Is what you carry worth anything?
My armor shines!

lines.zh: 这世界只有我能给你想要的！
lines.en: This world only I can give you what you want!
Check my weapon rack!

lines.zh: 这里的东西可都是梦魇精华！
lines.en: All items here are nightmare essence!

lines.zh: 我的交易永远公平公正！
lines.en: My trades are always fair!
Check my staff!
This is heaven for traders!
Don't miss these opportunities!

lines.zh: 熔岩锭堆在脚边，我懒得数。
lines.en: Lava ingots pile at my feet; I do not bother counting.
Check my runes!
I polish a blade one more time.
The wick on my stall burns green.

lines.zh: 我摸着下巴，算今天的账。
lines.en: I stroke my chin and tally today's accounts.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就跟影子聊两句。
lines.en: With no customers, I chat with my shadow.
Oh, a player appeared!
Player, I have what you need!
Hey, don't hide from me!
Player, come trade!
Hey, check my staff!
Player, I have the best!
Hey, check my gear!
Player, trade!
Hey, check my armor!
Player, what do you want?
I look up and show two rows of teeth.
A customer at last.

lines.zh: 我的目光先落在你口袋上。
lines.en: My gaze goes first to your pockets.
I look you over and price you on the spot.
Not much blood on you. A pity.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一件举给你看。
lines.en: I hold up my finest piece for you.
This nightmare body is injured...

lines.zh: 我的货摊，是梦魇世界唯一的门。
lines.en: My stall is the nightmare world's only door.
My skin is tearing...

lines.zh: 我的货还没换出去，别打。
lines.en: My goods are still unsold; stop hitting.

lines.zh: 千年生命也会被砍掉一截。
lines.en: Even a thousand years of life can be cut short.
I am torn...

lines.zh: 一箱货撒了，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: A crate spilled; I bend to gather it.
Pain is consuming me...
I am fatigued...
Infection is spreading...

lines.zh: 听到你的交易，我被饿意驱使！
lines.en: The hunger drives me to your offers.

lines.zh: 我闻到了食物的香味，无法抗拒！
lines.en: The scent of food calls to me.

lines.zh: 你给我的交易机会，我怎能错过？
lines.en: Such an opportunity, I cannot miss it.

lines.zh: 我的肚子在提醒我，快交易吧！
lines.en: My stomach reminds me to trade.

lines.zh: 食物和武器，我想要更多！
lines.en: More food and weapons, that’s what I want.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你很久了，快开始交易吧！
lines.en: I’ve been waiting for you, let’s trade.

lines.zh: 与我交易，你的生存将更轻松！
lines.en: Trade with me, make your survival easier.

lines.zh: 我需要更强的装备，来对付梦魇！
lines.en: I need better gear to fight the nightmare.

lines.zh: 你的交易对我意义重大！
lines.en: Your offer means a lot to me.

lines.zh: 梦魇之中的交易，让生存变得可能！
lines.en: Survival is possible through these trades.
Watch out, don’t bump into me.
You bumped into me, I’m angry.
You hurt me when you bumped into me.

lines.zh: 别再撞我了，我快要生气了！
lines.en: Stop bumping into me, I’m getting angry.

lines.zh: 我警告你，再撞我就攻击！
lines.en: I warn you, I’ll attack if you bump into me.

lines.zh: 别再碰我，我要保持距离！
lines.en: Don’t touch me, I need my space.
You bumped into me, I had to retaliate.
Don’t approach me, I’m angry.
You bumped into me, I’m leaving.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我是个梦魇商人！
lines.en: Don’t touch me, I’m a nightmare trader.
Mate with me, I’m strong.

lines.zh: 和我交配，你会变得更强大！
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll become stronger.

lines.zh: 找我交配，我有你需要的一切！
lines.en: Mate with me, I have what you need.

lines.zh: 和我交配吧，我的后代很优秀！
lines.en: Mate with me, our offspring will be excellent.
Mating is essential here.

lines.zh: 和我交配，你将拥有力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll have power.

lines.zh: 找我交配，你会变得更聪明！
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll become smarter.

lines.zh: 和我交配，你的生命会更长久！
lines.en: Mate with me, your life will be longer.

lines.zh: 找我交配，你会变得更敏捷！
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll become more agile.

lines.zh: 和我交配，你的梦魇之躯将增强！
lines.en: Mate with me, your nightmare form will be enhanced.
Sssss, human, trade with me.
My treasures, you can't lift them.
Your gaze shows desire.
Bring out your gold for weapons.

lines.zh: 在这片阴影中，一切皆可交易。
lines.en: In this shadow, everything can be traded.
My voice echoes in the nightmare.

lines.zh: 梦魇之中的秘密，我来揭示。
lines.en: The secrets of the nightmare, I reveal them.
What do you want? Give me gold.
Find the light in this darkness.
Trade done, may you be safe.
You are chosen.

lines.zh: 钱包还是脖子，我先掂量一下。
lines.en: Purse or throat; let me weigh which.
Notice, danger approaches.
Your soul will be devoured.

lines.zh: 想在我的摊子前跑？先付代价。
lines.en: Trying to run from my stall? Pay first.

lines.zh: 价格谈崩了，那就用刀谈。
lines.en: The price fell through; we talk with blades now.
Your weapon is useless to me.
Prepare for battle or be destroyed.
Trade ends, battle begins.
Victory in battle, trade fails.
Your weakness is targeted.
Target, shoot.
Be careful, you are targeted.
Prey locked, prepare to attack.
My gaze captures you.
Target clear, prepare to trade.
Lock target before trading.
Target weakness, one hit kills.
Target locked, trade begins.
Trade and battle, switch at will.
In Nightmare, prices are settled with teeth.
The shelves are here, so let us see the goods.
Hunger's fangs!

lines.zh: 不买东西还敢伸手，接我一下。
lines.en: You reach out without buying; take this.

lines.zh: 我的柜台，只换不做别的。
lines.en: My counter trades. It does nothing else.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿生来就为了吃你！
lines.en: My teeth are meant for you.
Taste nightmare poison!
Eat you, devour your soul!

lines.zh: 在我的铺子前闹事，走不掉的。
lines.en: Making trouble at my stall; you will not leave.
If you will not buy, do not blame my hands!

lines.zh: 梦魇世界的摊子，开张了。
lines.en: The nightmare stall is open.
Nightmare descends!
The nightmare stall opens today.
Dealer of the dark!
Only here can you trade!
The only buyer?
Choose, come!
I am the nightmare's messenger!
Trade life for life!
Find me in this darkness!

lines.zh: 梦魇里也会着火，真稀奇。
lines.en: Fire even in the nightmare realm; strange.
The merchant fell; who pays for the goods?
A merchant fears water. So does his stock.

lines.zh: 炸碎了我的柜台，生意难做。
lines.en: My counter is blown apart; trade is hard.
Projectile hit me...
Magic harmed me...
Starvation harmed me...
Here, all gear is up for trade.
Void tore me...
